mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals a strengthening consumer demand environment, which typically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising GDPC1 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
